name: D6 direct set-conditioned action-response pilot

data.split: same episode-held-out 220 TRAIN / 36 validation states as D4
data.nested_validation: groups from the same six held-out episodes

arms.independent_direct: state plus each action independently to one non-autoregressive 38-step response
arms.set_conditioned: same encoders/decoder with two permutation-equivariant self-attention blocks over all action queries

architecture.output: normalized 38 x 45 anonymous pose/velocity response relative to the common start
architecture.probe_count: uniform random integer from 32 through 64 per neighborhood batch

training.loss_weighting: non-response terms scale-matched to response on the first independent-direct batch and then frozen identically for both arms

pilot_gate.reference: matched independent_direct arm on the same held-out TRAIN states

if_pass: replicate fixed seeds 1-5 on TRAIN before freezing one DEV comparison
if_fail: stop D6; do not tune on validation or open DEV/TEST
